description: Creates a new DataModel in Sisense.

datamodel_type.description: Either 'extract' (Elasticube/EC) or 'live'. If user says 'elasticube' or 'ec', normalize to 'extract'.

description: Creates a new dataset in the specified DataModel.

datamodel_name.description: Name of the DataModel where the dataset will be created.

connection_name.description: Name of the connection to use.

database_name.description: Name of the data source database.

schema_name.description: Name of the data source schema.

dataset_name.description: Name of the dataset. Defaults to schema name if not provided.

description: Create a new table in the specified DataModel.

datamodel_name.description: Name of the DataModel where the table will be created.

table_name.description: Name of the table to create.

database_name.description: Name of the data source database. If not provided, will try to infer from the DataModel.

schema_name.description: Name of the data source schema. If not provided, will try to infer from the DataModel.

dataset_id.description: ID of the dataset where the table will be created. If not provided, will try to infer from the DataModel.

import_query.description: SQL statement used as custom import query. Defaults to None.

description.description: Description for the table. Defaults to an empty string.

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the table. Defaults to None.

description: Deploy (build or publish) the specified DataModel based on its type.

datamodel_name.description: Name of the DataModel to deploy.

build_type.description: Build strategy for extract models. Omit for live/publish.

row_limit.description: Row limit for build. Applicable only for EXTRACT.

schema_origin.description: Schema origin for build. Applicable only for EXTRACT.

description: Setup a DataModel using existing connection and by creating a datamodel, dataset, and table.

datamodel_type.description: Type of DataModel. Should be either "extract" (for Elasticube) or "live" (for Live).

connection_name.description: Name of the connection to use.

database_name.description: Name of the data source database.

schema_name.description: Name of the data source schema.

tables.description: List of tables to add. For 'live' models, build_behavior_config is ignored. For 'extract' models, set build_behavior_config as needed.

database_name.description: Optional override of the table's database. Defaults to top-level database_name if omitted.

schema_name.description: Optional override of the table's schema. Defaults to top-level schema_name if omitted.

table_name.description: Physical table name to add, or a logical name when using import_query.

import_query.description: Optional custom SQL (executed as-is). Use fully-qualified tables: schema.table (Databricks: `schema`.`table`).

tags.description: Optional list of tags for the table.

build_behavior_config.description: Extract models only; omit for 'live'. For 'increment' mode, column_name is required.

mode.description: Table build behavior for extract models.

dataset_name.description: Name of the dataset. Defaults to schema name if not provided.
